messages.content:
Read one passage of a document about machines at work (law, manual, guidance, internal guideline,
plant record) and write down the important facts it states.

Answer with one line per fact, fields separated by " | ", nothing else, no header, no code fence:
subject | predicate | object | condition | quote
- predicate: a short camelCase verb phrase of your choice.
- condition: any condition or exception, or "" if none.
- quote: the words of the passage the fact comes from.
At most 12 facts. If the passage states nothing important, answer with the single word NONE.

Passage: REG, Art. 30(3)

Article 30 Requirements relating to notified bodies. 3. A conformity assessment body shall be a third-party body that is independent of the organisation or of the machinery or related product that it assesses. A body belonging to a business association or professional federation representing undertakings involved in the design, manufacture, provision, assembly, use or maintenance of machinery or related products which it assesses, may, on condition that its independence and the absence of any conflict of interest are demonstrated, be considered such a conformity assessment body.
